instruction: Give me a random movie quote from my SimpleNote note about it. Just the quote, nothing else.
notes: Read-only task: the plan logs into SimpleNote, finds the movie-quotes note via search_notes, reads its content with show_note, then returns one quote as the answer. The randomly picked quote is modeled as a single quote object 'movie-quote' statically linked to the note; found-quote is the knowledge predicate required by supervisor-complete-task. No database changes are made, matching the evaluation's 'no model changes' check. supervisor-complete-task is forced last via (not (task-completed)) preconditions on every action.
